caption: The drawing features a single object: an old-fashioned lantern. It is rendered in shades of gray, suggesting the use of graphite or pencil on a neutral, lightly toned background. The lantern has a rounded, bulbous glass chamber with decorative etching and some unreadable text or letters on its surface. The metal top of the lantern is perforated with small holes and fitted to a broad, round base. A large, curved handle arches above the lantern, attached on both sides near the top, with a small clasp or notch at the apex of the handle. The surface details and shading give a realistic depiction of the metallic and glass textures. The lower left corner of the drawing contains a hand-signed name in cursive. There are no additional objects or background elements present in the composition.
title: Hand Lantern
